📌 Tehran, IRNA – The Director-General of Consular Affairs, Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Islamic Republic of Iran, Mojtaba Shasti Karimi, says Iraq has repatriated 48 Iranian prisoners under a bilateral agreement on the transfer of sentenced prisoners.

Shasti Karimi said on Monday that 48 Iranian nationals imprisoned in Iraq were transferred to Iran to complete their sentences through the Mehran border crossing. He also said another 159 prisoners will be transferred through the Shalamcheh border crossing on September 20.
​
He added that these transfers are under an agreement between Iran and Iraq on transferring sentenced prisoners, coordinated with the Judiciary and the Ministries of Foreign Affairs and Justice.
​
Shashti Karimi emphasized that one of the main missions of the Foreign Ministry is to pursue the release, pardon, and transfer of Iranian prisoners to the country, as well as to provide legal and consular support to Iranians abroad.
